summary: Baozun Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on June 17, 2026, reporting the poll results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held June 16, 2026. No special-situation terms, transactions, or strategic changes were disclosed; the filing simply confirms shareholder votes on routine matters. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 summarizes the AGM outcome. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, or other transformative event. The document is a standard current report of annual meeting results and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
